statement: Stage 2 of docs/cairn-integration-plan.md: the measured frontier of the ecdlp.single_target problem on prime-field curves with planted targets, in the ecbench.gae unit (group-addition equivalents, the whole method, cold, one target), at the toy tier (fields of at most 32 bits). An artifact is a sealed bound record (aburan28/crypto docs/bounds/README.md, schema ecbench.bound/v1) fitted by ecbench from an audited session. The pinned evaluator recomputes every size's S = mean_gae / sqrt(r) and its ratio to the generic floor sqrt(pi / 2A) from the record's own counts, the pooled ratio from the sizes, the tier from the field sizes and the domain from its fields, refuses a record that disagrees with itself, measures time, lies outside this domain or tier, or is not admissible, and scores the parts per million of the floor achieved: 1000000 at the floor, higher is closer. It cannot verify that the named sessions exist and replay -- that is the measuring repository's CI (ecbench bound check, ecbench verify --replay-all) and an independent receipt cited by hash in the record -- so an accept here is a receipt for a well-formed, self-consistent frontier entry and backs no direction in this program's ledger on its own (invariant b). reward is 0: nobody outside this program funds it yet, and the frontier is the point, not the payout. One objective is one domain and one tier (invariant d): another domain is a copy of the checker with other constants, hence another hash, hence another objective.

ratchet.scale: parts per million of the generic floor sqrt(pi / 2A)

verifier.shape_note: The evaluator and ratchet field names above follow docs/cairn-integration-plan.md section 1 and are to be confirmed against cairn's examples/ (22 evaluator objectives) before this file is posted; tools/exp_to_objective.py check renders certificate and replay objectives only.

bound_id.description: ECBND1h followed by 12 hex digits: the SHA-256 of the record's bytes with this field empty.

domain.description: problem ecdlp.single_target, family prime, target_kind planted, unit ecbench.gae, tier toy, envelope one cold target without precomputation.

sizes.description: One row per curve: slug, r, field_bits <= 32, automorphisms_available, floor_s, runs == verified > 0, mean_gae, mean_s, ratio_to_floor; every stated figure recomputes from the counts.

constant.description: ratio_to_floor.value equals the run-weighted mean of the sizes' ratios.

dimensions.description: ops.known true and ops.value equal to constant.ratio_to_floor.value.

provenance.description: sessions named by directory, session id and the SHA-256 of records.jsonl; verified equal to the sum over sizes.
